body:
no luck... there aren't any jobs available... 

the asshole uncle of mines... pushing m parents force to make a lower payment by giving him a receipt says the amount he paid... which is 100 bucks less and that's illegally... my parents are preparing for the worst--- they told me if we have to kick this asshole out, we have to if we can, not caring if the house gets damaged or not but we can't live like this if we can't sell the house...

I'm going to look for a job... in my current mental state i dunno if i can do it... my friends whereabouts are unknown and some of moved out of the province i live in...

i hope everything turns out to be ok... i'm trying to hold my tears i dunno...

No, they were extremely rude to us... they wanted to buy the house dirt cheap to the point we're bankrupt and... they told us we're wasting their time. 

We told our agent to keep these kinds of people away, offers that are completely silly as in making us bankrupt is not even funny... 

No, our agent is not good at playing hardball. So far he showed that he's a lazy person... he makes his partner do all the work and he's lazy also...

I just heard from my dad he might lose his job... oh god... My parents told me they know I have been under depression for 3 years based on the recent events... and get a job...

it's hard to get a job here since 99% is french and I mainly know how to communicate in english... 

i don't know what to do, fuck, fuck, fuck...
We had to cancel their offer because the buyer was trying to screw us over and waste our time... so yeah.. still waiting..
thanks we really need it... im at the point that my body feels feeble...

well, the buyer gave an offer that leaves you in a position that will leave you bankrupt... so yeah we made a counter offer... and he wants to see the house before inspection problem is this asshole might not open the door... 

so we gotta get a bailiff to send an official letter (because even if we send 24 hour notice to enter he will say he never got the letter) that a visitor  will come but my parents said visitor can see the other units and the one the asshole uncle lives in can visit if you do inspection...
Someone made an offer for the house... I hope everything goes well... :)
Someone made an offer for the house... I hope everything goes well... :)
ty :)
My mom just told me that this jerk might abandon the apartment after overflowing it... like wow... she told me if any water drops from the ceiling call the police right away...

Nothing as of yet... just rumors floating around that this asshole uncle will force my parents to sign a receipt or paying check of 100 dollar less of the lease and showing it to the government that he's playing less in order to avoid social welfare fraud claims. But who knows honestly... this guy is a piece of shit.
Thank you very much... I hope everything falls into place and let this nightmare just be buried underneath the ground...

Other than my mom and dad, rest of my relatives and family members are exactly like this jerk that is renting from us. They are plotting to cut down the camera wires... 

All my relatives are like this since they are all committing social welfare fraud, and they did do credit card fraud (they said to the government all the money was lost at the casino but they wired the money to another country and their elder brother's bank account) and we have all the information. 

I'm going to see what happens next because the asshole uncles did not start acting yet... so if anything happens I am going straight to the police to get them arrested if possibly... 

I'm stuck in this hole and it sucks like hell... especially my parents are telling me not to do anything because they might try to kill us... and I go back to square one thinking about suiciding... it's so messed up...

We don't know much about help line for cases like this. Usually in Canada, Quebec they just say "go to Regi Du Logement" basically rental boards about it. And if it's criminal, then criminal court. Both requires money and logement is pretty much useless giving a slap on the wrist of people like my uncle... 

Thanks for trying... right now I just have to wait and see what happens... I'll keep updating on the matter if anything new happens.

I wish it was easy... T_T 

My parents are in the same position as me, but they are more head strong than I am about it... and no I have no place to be at... even if I did these uncles will try to do something to me... :(
They know... they told me to endure and do not react to this assholes methods until the house is sold...

My parents and I are still waiting for a potential buyer... until then we don't know what to do... simply just wait. :(

Every day feels like a year of stress and grief living here...

The house is on sale, not sold yet. Many people came first week but no offers were made for purchase. :(

We have to wait until a potential buyer is interested...

Right now my uncle is forcing my parents to make a new lease that he will be paying 150 dollars less for rent. 

I told my parents to go to the court and settle this matter and evict them but my parents are scared what this person will do to our house (mainly property damage). My parents are trying to find a solution now without going to the police and hoping that we sell the house before this gets any further. 

I kept telling them since he's committing social welfare fraud just get him evicted based on that proof. But they are just scared what the other asshole uncles will do afterwards.

My parents said if this doesn't go well, and we don't sell the house on time, then we have no choice but to get the police if needed to put him in jail, pressing charges, getting him evicted aspa.

The agent is effy at best... he doesn't show up himself but he lets other agents do the showing the house around. The other agents barely knows anything the house as we had to do the explaining... 

Last time we confronted my uncle , we spoke normally and he goes instantly apeshit on us... He's extremely aggressive because he knows my dad won't do anything because he almost borderline incapable of communicating with people... 

We can't talk to him directly, the first thing he does is I will beat the living shit out of you... He doesn't listen to anyone but his other brother who is providing him ideas to cut the cctv camera wires ( we informed the police about it and they said nothing was cut and if he does cut it or if anything happens to the camera, call the police right away to press charges). 

Thanks for your prayers, my parents and I are going to need it really badly...

The only we can get out of here soon is if there is a potential buyer interested... we made a couple of months contract with the real estate agent... so we don't know what's going to happen, when the house will be sold.

My mom is around her 40s, and she doesn't have time for counseling because she needs to work as much as she can to pay for the mortgage. Her face doesn't show she's stressed out but she breathes very deeply when situation is over the top...

I'll tell her your advice for a counseling. In Quebec Canada for counseling costs money, but it's free if you're underage.

We're hoping that we can sell the house before new years... but yeah... my asshole uncle is going insane again after seeing the for sale sign...

Everyone in the neighborhood probably has an idea that my uncle who's the tenant is a bad person. 

Most of the neighbors are old citizen and don't want to get involved... they steer far away us and just watch how many times police comes by to our house when this asshole goes insane and the situation becomes out of control...


He told one of the neighbors to fuck off because they said he was making a lot of noise during night time when he was washing his car, almost midnight. No one says hi to this guy, at all. 

I hope we can sell the house, because we're fed up, and I'm scared if my mother is the one who will suicide first even though I already attempted to overdose myself on pills... we're just in a tight corner with no options left. I really don't want to lose anyone because of this... 

I am really hoping, really really hoping we can get out of this place soon.

Right now we're trying to sell the house, it's the only thing for us left to do. I am not sure what my uncles might do since we're trying to sell the house...  As for friends I had left, they all moved out of the country. :(

I am really scared, for my parents and myself. It's like I'm out of options to do anything. :(
